tooltip_share_saved_servers:
Optional. Shares only saved server addresses with the shared GameMonitoring cache.
No Rust logs, Steam ID, account data, or player names are sent.
tooltip_swarm:
Optional. Shares only the selected server address and a local availability signal through Swarm.
No Rust logs, Steam ID, account data, or automatic launch are shared.
